extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing and scoped search, controls HLS quality and MP4 buffering, and can persist downloaded subtitles for replay.
extension.news: 0.5.0 - Fix movie-folder failures with visible Fire TV errors, index TV shows for faster navigation, add explicit title/year sorting, HLS pre-play quality selection or bitrate limiting, native Kodi MP4 cache controls, and persistent downloaded subtitle reuse.
